Restore your body’s natural rhythms with our unique, full-spectrum magnesium, crafted from organic seaweed and mineralized seawater to channel the balanced vitality of the tides. Primary Ingredients Magnesium from Organic Sea Lettuce Extract Seaweed is an excellent source of magnesium, and sea lettuce has the highest natural magnesium content of all known seaweeds. We extract our organic sea lettuce using purified seawater, which yields a highly soluble form of magnesium coupled with natural carotenoids, B vitamins, and chlorophyll. This kind of multi-form magnesium complex ensures optimal absorption and bioavailability. Magnesium from Purified Seawater Concentrate Seawater is not only a fantastic source of soluble magnesium, it also provides a matrix of essential trace minerals like calcium, potassium, and selenium. Our mineral-rich seawater is sourced from the pristine Irish Sea and yields highly bioavailable magnesium salt that is gentle on your stomach and works in harmony with your body. Magnesium from Organically Bound Spirulina Minerals like magnesium naturally seek attachments to organic, living compounds – like the abundant proteins in spirulina. By binding magnesium to an organic whole food like spirulina, it is better tolerated by your digestive tract, more easily absorbed, and delivers additional plant-based compounds like beta carotene for enhanced bioavailability. Certified Organic Irish Sea Moss Irish sea moss contains a full spectrum of minerals – like iodine, calcium, potassium, and sodium – which can help your body better utilize supplemental magnesium through electrolyte balance and mineral transport. Our certified organic Irish sea moss is sustainably wild harvested from the Gulf of Maine, then sun-dried and gently milled to preserve its precious mineral matrix. Certified Organic Atlantic Wakame Nestled in the leaves of Atlantic wakame is an array of phytonutrients, including chlorophyll and potent antioxidants, that work alongside magnesium to promote healthy energy metabolism and cellular vitality. Our certified organic wakame is sustainably cultivated in the open waters of Maine. The seaweed is grown on low-impact longlines, then gently harvested, sun-dried, and slow-milled to maintain peak nutrient density. Primary Ingredients Certified Organic Red Raspberry Leaf Red raspberry leaf has been a favored prenatal herb among moms-to-be for centuries. Known for promoting a healthy uterus, the bioactives in red raspberry leaves foster healthy uterine blood flow and smooth muscle function during pregnancy and labor. Our organic extract is concentrated for maximum support. Methylated Folate (MTHF) Folate tops the list of critical vitamins during pregnancy due to its essential role in promoting healthy neural tube development. The metabolically active form of folate – methylated folate – bypasses the need for enzyme activation, making it a highly bioavailable and effective form of this critical B vitamin. Iron Iron is a core mineral for optimal red blood cell production and function, and pregnancy demands extra iron to support a healthy blood supply for both mom and baby. Our plant-based iron is fermented and combined with nutrient cofactors so it’s gentle on your stomach and easily absorbed. Choline Choline is a key vitamin for upholding mom’s daily energy, and supporting baby’s brain and neurological development both during pregnancy and while breastfeeding. Vitamin C Antioxidants like vitamin C are essential during pregnancy for supporting mom and baby’s immune systems, promoting healthy bone and collagen production, and enhancing iron absorption. Our naturally sourced vitamin C is complexed with cofactors and enzymes for peak antioxidant capacity. Formulated for bioavailability, Bone Renewal® combines plant-based vitamins and trace minerals with nourishing botanical extracts to uphold natural bone health as you age. Primary Ingredients Calcium from Certified Organic Algae Calcium is essential for healthy bones and teeth, but it’s a nutrient that works best when absorbed alongside other vitamins and minerals. That’s why we source our calcium from organic red algae. Grown in the pure waters of Iceland, our organic algae yields a highly bioavailable form of calcium and its cofactors for optimal bone health. Vitamin D3 from Certified Organic Algae Vitamin D3 ensures calcium is optimally absorbed, making it a vital nutrient for strong, healthy bones. Most D3 supplements are derived from sheep’s wool, or tree-grown lichen, which can deplete natural resources. Our vegan vitamin D3 is from organic algae for a pure, plant-friendly source of this essential vitamin. Vitamin K1 and K2 Both vitamins K1 and K2 are bone health essentials. They partner with vitamin D3 to support the absorption and use of calcium, maintaining optimal bone composition and strength. Vitamin K is also key to collagen production, which supports healthy mobility. Magnesium from Certified Organic Algae and Sea Minerals Considered a bone essential, magnesium supports the function of bone cells, facilitates other bone-fortifying minerals and hormones, and maintains a balanced response within joints. Our bioavailable magnesium complex combines organic Icelandic red algae and minerals from the Dead Sea for optimal support. Plant-Based Minerals Minerals like boron and strontium are the supporting cast for healthy bone structure. Even though only small amounts are required, these tiny titans play a vital role in upholding bone strength and integrity. Our suite of plant-based trace minerals is sourced from fermented algae and rice for optimal absorption. Deeply nourishing super greens, fruits, herbs, and mushrooms are meticulously blended, harnessing timeless healing wisdom, to help balance body and mind. Deeply nourishing super greens, fruits, herbs, and mushrooms are meticulously blended, harnessing timeless healing wisdom, to help balance body and mind. Crafted with more than 60 organic ingredients, our highly researched superfood formula was the first of its kind, to this day often imitated and never equaled. Deeply nourishing super greens, fruits, herbs, and mushrooms are meticulously blended, harnessing timeless healing wisdom, to help balance body and mind. Primary Ingredients Certified Organic Super Greens Sprouts, grasses, roots, and algae are all charged with life-giving energy. At the foundation of the Earth’s food chain, these vibrant superfoods are concentrated with phytonutrients that help spark cellular energy and foster mental focus and clarity. Certified Organic Berries & Botanicals Plants are an exceptional source of age-defying antioxidants. Red algae like dulse and dunaliella, plus berries like blueberry and raspberry, all deliver potent carotenoids that promote cellular youth and rejuvenation. Fantastic fungi like reishi, shiitake, and maitake all carry unique polysaccharides and phytonutrients that help optimize your immune defense. The roots, leaves, and flowers of these herbs boast bioactive compounds that promote daily balance and resilience. Our organic schisandra and eleuthero pair with calming botanicals like skullcap to fuel your daily fortitude. Primary Ingredients Lactase Enzyme Lactase is responsible for digesting lactose, the sugar commonly found in dairy. However, many lack the natural ability to produce the lactase enzyme, leading to discomfort digesting dairy-rich foods. By supplementing lactase, it’s easier for your body to digest these lactose-rich foods. Cellulase Enzyme Cellulase is responsible for digesting cellulose, the key compound in plant fiber. However, humans do not naturally produce cellulase enzymes, which can make it hard for your body to access all the nutrients of plant-based foods. Meaning taking cellulase can enhance the nutritive value of fruits, vegetables, and grains.
